conviction_note: Two findings on public monthly data pull opposite ways: the Jun-Aug quarter (SSS -2.0/-5.1/+5.3 against a +5.5% sales comp) very likely prints a YoY operating-profit decline, which is what sold this stock -8.5% at the open last year, and the September SSS of +10.4% gives management a strong start to the second half; H1 will almost certainly beat the company's own H1 plan, but that has been visible since Q1 progress hit 56.7%. The net is -0.5, deliberately small, because every input is already public, the stock barely moved on the September monthly, and Shimamura has never raised full-year guidance at H1 (it held it in both 2024 and 2025).
bar: Company H1 plan (unrevised, restated in the Q1 tanshin of 2026-06-29): sales 359,887m, OP 32,067m, ordinary 33,159m yen; full year OP 66,842m / ordinary 68,825m. Source: https://finance.biggo.jp/news/jpx_tdnet_140120260628582586 (mirror of the TDnet Q1 決算短信). Sell-side FY ordinary consensus is 69,632m, unchanged for 4 weeks (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=8227). No H1 consensus was sourced, so the market's actual bar for Q2 cannot be pinned down and all sizes are kept small. My estimate is Q2 OP of about 14.5-15.5bn against 16,150m last year and 14,177m implied by the plan, which puts H1 ordinary around 34-35bn, +3 to +6% over the plan.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register as of 20260918: 0.0% with no position at or above 0.5% and no change (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 6.68x (kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=8227, 2026-09-28), so leveraged retail is crowded long. That is the margin_overhang component (-0.41) behind priced_lean -0.248. There are no options, so there is no skew. With no crowded short, a negative print has nothing to squeeze. The crowded margin long makes a disappointment more likely to extend than to bounce. Sell-side: GS Sell with a 3,000 target (2026-06-30) and Okasan initiating at Neutral with 3,600 (2026-07-29), per kabutan rating digests.

findings.finding: Jun-Aug (Q2) Shimamura-format same-store sales ran -2.0% (June), -5.1% (July) and +5.3% (August), and all-store sales -1.7/-4.7/+5.8, roughly flat for the quarter against a Q2 last year when group sales rose +5.5%. Q1 SG&A grew +4.8% while gross margin was flat YoY (34.95% vs 34.94%), so Q2 operating profit very likely falls YoY, by roughly 5-10% against 16,150m. In September 2025 a Q2 OP decline of -4% produced a -8.5% gap at the open.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 YoY OP is the line this stock trades at H1. 2025-09-30: Q2 OP -4.0% and H1 about 1.5bn under the market, FY held, gap -8.47% and close -9.48% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8227&b=n202509300365). 2024-10-01: Q2 OP +7.6% and about 0.5bn over consensus, FY held, gap +3.83% and close +6.22% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8227&b=n202410010354). Q1 2026-06-30: OP +16.8%, about 2bn over consensus, gapped +4.2% and closed only +0.8%, which FISCO attributed to the weak June monthly.
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced. The monthlies are public and the stock sits 5% below its 24 Aug level (3,390 to 3,216). But FY consensus has not moved in 4 weeks and sits only 1.2% above the company guide, and the Q1 print set a high reference. If the market fully expected a Q2 decline of 5-10%, I would expect visible consensus cuts or a larger drawdown than the -3.3% 20-day run-up. It is sized small because the monthlies are exactly what Japanese readers already price.
findings.independence: June: https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s070844.html (2026-07-08). August: https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s091142.html (2026-09-11). Q1 P&L for the SG&A and gross-margin trend: https://finance.biggo.jp/news/jpx_tdnet_140120260628582586. The monthly articles all rest on the company's own monthly releases, so this is one series; the Q1 cost structure is a different document.

findings.finding: The September monthly (Aug 21-Sep 20, the first month of H2), published 2026-09-24, shows same-store sales +10.4% (customers +3.8%, ticket +6.8%), with sales above last year in every region. The stock moved only +0.3% and +0.7% on the two sessions after it, and that month gives management a strong basis for its second-half commentary at the H1 briefing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Shimamura held its full-year guidance at H1 in both 2024 and 2025 and has not raised it at H1 in the kabutan revision history. In 2024 the stock rose +6.2% on an H1 beat, with FISCO citing margin-improvement expectations for H2, so second-half tone carried the reaction even with the guide held.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock closed at 3,195 on 9/24 and 3,216 on 9/25 against 3,185 before the release, about 1% for a double-digit comp at the start of H2. Kabutan wrote no article on it, where it covered every previous monthly this year. If it were priced, I would expect a move comparable to the +1.8% on the weaker August monthly, or a consensus uptick. The market appears to be waiting for the print. The upside is capped because the company is unlikely to raise the full-year guide.
findings.independence: The Yahoo 掲示板 thread of 2026-09-24 discusses it (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/8227.T/forum) but quotes different figures (112.9% same-store), so it is not load-bearing. The only figure used is the Wealth Advisor one.

outside_window.finding: Purchase of the 21 Colmopia clothing stores from Summit, to be converted to Shimamura stores. Completion reported for March next year, so it does not affect H1 or the print.

searched_and_found_nothing: Q1 inventory build (+17.1bn) looked like summer overstock but matches last year's +17.9bn, so it is seasonal and not a finding: https://finance.biggo.jp/news/jpx_tdnet_140120260628582586

Taiwan subsidiary capital increase of 970m TWD (特定子会社の異動, 2026-08-31) is a growth injection into a negative-net-assets unit with no P&L effect: https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120260831528388.pdf
No 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正 filed before the print (TDnet lists 8/31 and 9/7, kabutan news list)
Shimamura IR site (shimamura.gr.jp, monthly pages and assets-c PDFs) returns 403 to both curl and WebFetch, so segment monthlies for Avail and Birthday were not obtained
No H1 sell-side consensus found; kabuyoho shows only FY and Q1 figures
Nikkei had no pre-print 観測 article on H1 profit (https://www.nikkei.com/nkd/company/news/?scode=8227)
Last year's H1 tanshin could not be fetched, so last year's Q2 gross margin is not in hand
baseline_tension: The small net negative agrees with the baseline lean (-0.25, driven by the 6.68x margin overhang) and with the -3.3% 20-day run-up, so it adds little beyond the positioning. The September monthly is the one input that cuts against the lean, and the price has not reacted to it.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: researcher_japan/LESSONS.md holds no rules yet (no Japanese run has resolved). Its open question 2, whether monthlies pre-empt the print, matches the reason both findings were already sized small, but as a question it did not move any number.
